notes: AI-assisted manual review (optional, self-configured endpoint/model/key stored locally). Offline by default; the opt-in version check is read-only and multi-source and never uploads table data. Downloaded bytes must embed TOOL_VERSION >= the announced latest. New in 1.3.2: version check and download retry silently up to 3 times (900ms apart) when every source fails, so a brief network outage does not block the reviewer. Final answers are always chosen by the native-speaker human reviewer.
